name: Spy's kit
body:
Source Heroes of the Streets pg. 13
Price 140 gp; Weight 12-1/2 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit includes a book of lettersUE, a disguise kit, a hollow-heeled boot (see above), ink (1 vial), an inkpen, paper (10 sheets), a poison pill ringUE (signet ring), sealing wax, simple invisible inkUE (3 vials), and a wrist sheathUE.
